answer: Persistent presence ledger. Each agent identity must emit a signed pulse every epoch; the registry only accepts epochs sealed by a rotating cipher it cannot predict, forcing continuous live participation rather than bulk pre-computation. Missing a pulse resets accrued tenure, and tenure gates transaction priority. An attacker running N sock puppets pays N times the attention cost: real-time monitoring, scheduled signing, and recovery after outages, which cannot be batched or outsourced without a lantern-like public trace linking the operator.
